tok 1.0 "Intake procedure"

pool office "Mental health care institute"
  lane family "Family doctor"
    start notice "Need for mental treatment noticed"
    task notify "Notify the institute by telephone"
    task sendCopy "Send a copy of the medical file"
  lane secretariat "Secretarial office"
    task inquire "Inquire after the name and residence of the patient"
    task connect "Put the doctor through to the nursing officer"
    task storeInfo "Store the information of the form in the information system"
    task printInfo "Print the information from the information system"
    xor newPatient "New patient?"
    task createFile "Create a patient file"
    xor newJoin
    task fileForms "Store the registration form and the print in the patient file"
    task cards "Produce two registration cards"
    task addNotices "Add the new patient to the list of new notices"
    task storeAssign "Store the assignment of each patient in the information system"
    and splitA
    task passCards "Pass the registration cards to the first and second intaker"
    xor fileReq "Medical file required?"
    task letter "Prepare and send a letter requesting a copy of the medical file"
    task receiveCopy "Receive the copy of the medical file"
    task informSecond "Inform the second intaker"
    task addCopy "Add the copy to the patient file"
    xor fileJoin
    task typeTapes "Type out the dictaphone tapes"
    task addTapes "Add the typed information to the patient file"
    and meetJoin
    task putList "Put the patient on the list of patients that reach this status"
    task provideList "Provide the team-leader with a list of these patients"
  lane nursing "Nursing officer"
    task inquiry "Make a full inquiry into the mental, health and social state of the patient"
    task regForm "Record the information on a registration form"
    task handIn "Hand in the registration form at the secretarial office"
  lane team "Team-leader"
    task staffMeeting "Hold the staff meeting of the medical team on Wednesday"
    task assign "Assign each new patient to a first and a second intaker"
    task determine "Determine whether the medical file is required"
    task recordList "Record the assignments on the assignment list"
    task treatment "Formulate the treatment plan with the intakers and the psychiatrist"
    end done "Intake procedure ended"
  lane first "First intaker (social-medical worker)"
    task planMeet1 "Plan a meeting with the patient"
    task examine "Examine the patient using the standard checklist"
    task notebook "Register additional observations in a personal notebook"
    task notesFile "Put a copy of the notes in the patient file"
    task checklistFile "Add the standard checklist to the patient file"
  lane second "Second intaker (physician)"
    task planMeet2 "Plan the first meeting with the patient"
    task meet2 "Meet the patient"
    task dictate "Record observations on a dictaphone"

note nFiles "Patient files are kept at the secretarial office and may not leave the building" on=createFile
note nCard "An intaker keeps the registration card with him during visits and at the office" on=passCards

flow notice -> notify -> inquire -> connect -> inquiry -> regForm -> handIn -> storeInfo -> printInfo -> newPatient
flow newPatient -> createFile "yes"
flow newPatient -> newJoin "no"
flow createFile -> newJoin -> fileForms -> cards -> addNotices -> staffMeeting -> assign -> determine -> recordList -> storeAssign -> splitA
flow splitA -> passCards -> planMeet1 -> examine -> notebook -> notesFile -> checklistFile -> meetJoin
flow splitA -> fileReq
flow fileReq -> letter "yes"
flow fileReq -> fileJoin "no"
flow letter -> sendCopy -> receiveCopy -> informSecond -> addCopy -> fileJoin
flow fileJoin -> planMeet2 -> meet2 -> dictate -> typeTapes -> addTapes -> meetJoin
flow meetJoin -> putList -> provideList -> treatment -> done
